description: Phase 3d gate — atomic-rename commit durability. Verifies: (a) normal mutate/close/reopen commits the new bytes; (b) an existing <path>.leap-stage file is unlinked on open (cleanup from prior crashed process) and does NOT pollute the read of <path>; (c) multiple commit cycles accumulate state correctly; (d) the Phase 3a/3b single-page and multi-page behaviour is unchanged under the new close protocol. All 1..3b fixtures must stay green. Cross-build equivalence required.

schema.case: inherits phase3b.json schema plus one new field:
schema.preload_staging_hex: string — optional, disk-only. Hex bytes (no prefix, no separators) written to <path>.leap-stage BEFORE the first open. Harness zero-pads to at least 4096 bytes. The open protocol MUST unlink this file; the test then proceeds as if it never existed.

cases.name: disk-normal-commit-survives-reopen
cases.description: Baseline: mutate, close (atomic-rename commit), reopen, bytes are visible.

cases.name: disk-staging-leftover-cleaned-on-open
cases.description: A stale .leap-stage file exists before the first open. The open MUST unlink it and read <path> normally. The stale file's content MUST NOT leak into the session's read of <path>.

cases.name: disk-multiple-commit-cycles
cases.description: Open/mutate/close three times, each cycle persists its mutations.

cases.name: disk-3a-regression-empty-db-still-reads
cases.description: Phase 3a behaviour under the 3d protocol: empty DB round-trip.
